root_cause: When the drawer is opened via the button, focus remains on the triggering button or the body instead of moving inside the dialog, preventing keyboard users from interacting with the filter controls.
repair_strategy: Override the _onBeforeShow method in the Drawer class to move focus to the close button (#filters-close) after initializing swipe gestures, ensuring the dialog receives initial focus upon opening.
expected_accessibility_effect: Upon opening the filters drawer, focus will be placed on the close button, allowing users to press Tab to navigate to the 'In stock' checkbox and interact with the form using only the keyboard.
functional_risks: If the close button is absent or dynamically removed, the focus attempt will be safely skipped due to the null check.
The focus change occurs after swipe initialization, preserving existing touch/swipe behavior.
verification_requirements: After activating the filters button with Enter, the active element must be #filters-close.
Subsequent Tab presses must move focus to #in-stock, then #waterproof, then #apply, and loop correctly.
Pressing Space on a checkbox must toggle its checked state.
Pressing Enter on the 'Show results' button must update the applied filter output and close the drawer.
